{{Quote|She has spoken, and we treasure her words. Honor the Chronicles of Ki Sazen.|Nikto Cultist|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Chronicles of Ki Sazen''' were a series of holorecordings made in honor of the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] and were created during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At some point, Ki Sazen was noted to have [[Death/Legends|slain]] a [[Spine dragon/Legends|Spine dragon]] which led to her becoming revered by a group of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who formed a [[Cult of Ki Sazen|cult]] that worshipped her. Her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] urged her to release them from the [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]], however, Ki Sazen believed that she along with these Nikto followers were capable of greatness.

After the incident at [[Tas-La]], Sazen had fallen from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and departed with her Nikto cultists to the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. At some point, they created holorecordings of her words and teachings which they called the Chronicles of Ki Sazen. An [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] was tasked with the recovery of the various Chronicles with these revealing more of the fallen Jedi's origins.

==Behind the scenes==
These chronicles are mentioned in the optional quest called ''"Chronicles"'' that involves finding five chronicles that contain recordings from Ki Sazen.
